import subprocess, sys, json
def call(data):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'submission/main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout[:60], p.stderr[:200]

tests = {
 'deep nesting': (b'[' * 200000 + b']' * 200000),
 'deep nesting 2': (b'{"a":' * 50000 + b'1' + b'}' * 50000),
 'huge string': json.dumps({'version':1, 'x': 'y'*1000000}).encode(),
 'many small arrays': (b'[' + b','.join([b'1']*1000000) + b']'),
 'invalid utf8 mid': b'{"version":1,"config":\xff}',
 'nul byte': b'\x00',
 'just newline': b'\n',
 '16MiB spaces': b' ' * (16*1024*1024 - 1),
 '16MiB+ spaces': b' ' * (16*1024*1024 + 1),
 'crlf doc': b'\r\n' + json.dumps({'version':1}).encode(),
}
for name, data in tests.items():
    try:
        rc, out, err = call(data)
        print('%-20s rc=%d out=%s err=%r' % (name, rc, out[:40], err[:60]))
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print('%-20s TIMEOUT' % name)
EOF
